mapper.select: select user_id from user_follow where followed_user_id=#{userId}
select f.followed_user_id from user_follow as f left join user_role as ur on f.followed_user_id=ur.user_id where f.user_id=#{userId} and ur.role_id in (1,2)
select f.followed_user_id from user_follow as f left join user_role as ur on f.followed_user_id=ur.user_id where f.user_id=#{userId} and ur.role_id in (3)
select count(1) from user as u left join user_follow as j on u.id=j.user_id where j.followed_user_id=#{userId} and u.id < #{lastId}
